description: The donut-style pie chart presents the modality distribution for the MMAR benchmark, showing a total of seven labeled categories as slices. The slices include Speech (29.4%), shown in a medium lavender/purple segment; Mix-Sound-Speech (21.8%), in a very light lavender segment; Music (20.6%), in a light purple segment; Sound (16.5%), in a pale lavender segment; Mix-Music-Speech (8.2%), in a darker purple segment; Mix-Sound-Music-Speech (2.4%), in a narrow medium-purple slice; and Mix-Sound-Music (1.1%), in a very thin, very light slice. Percentage values are printed directly on the larger slices, while the smallest two slices are annotated with text outside the ring using leader lines. No separate legend is shown, and no slice appears visually exploded or offset; the segments appear arranged roughly from larger slices to smaller ones around the ring, with the smallest categories clustered near the top.
